title: Upgrade the remaining Test-scene lab objects into detailed prefabs
description:
## Summary
The Test-scene lab (`Assets/Test.unity`) now holds detailed prefab terminals: `Lab Multi Console`, `Lab Operator Console`, and `Lab Rack Cabinet` under `Assets/Prefabs/Lab/`, plus a shared material/texture set (TSK-0257). Every other lab object is still a loose, low-detail ProBuilder or primitive object placed directly in the scene and is not reusable.

Upgrade the remaining objects into detailed models and convert the reusable ones into prefab assets under `Assets/Prefabs/Lab/`, following the new `.github/skills/decorate-scene/SKILL.md` workflow.

Objects still needing detail work, in priority order:
1. `Lab Bench N`, `Lab Bench W`, `Lab Bench S` (+ Bench S/N Drawers) - workbenches with under-counter cabinets, rails, edge trim, power strips, shelf lighting.
2. `Lab Vat A/B/C` (Plinth, Base, Body, Collar, Cap, Hub, Specimen, Feed, Fluid) - specimen tanks with frame ribs, pipework, gauges, hatch, hazard trim, indicator lamps.
3. `Lab Retro Desk A/B` (Desk, Monitor, Screen, Keyboard, Foot, Box) - the retro CRT consoles, which are the least detailed terminals left.
4. `Lab Ring Light` and `Lab Ceiling` - light fixture detail, ceiling trays, conduits.
5. `Lab Tank A/B`, `Lab Tube Rack S`, `Lab Test Tube 1-6`, `Lab Beaker 1-4`, `Lab Scope *`, `Lab Centrifuge` - small science props.
6. Walls, wall panels, pillars, stage plinth/platform/rim/hazard ring, floor, `Lab Screen`.

## User Mandate
> "Then create a handoff for the next agent to take over and create more detailed models for the other objects and turn them into prefabs as necessary"

STRICT. Binding constraints:
- More detailed models for the other (non-terminal) lab objects.
- Turn them into prefabs as necessary.
- Delivered through a handoff to the next agent.

## Scope
In scope: ProBuilder geometry, materials, procedural textures, prefab assets, and placement in `Assets/Test.unity`; retiring replaced loose scene objects.
Out of scope: glass display cases (TSK-0258); creature generation, DNA, mesh extraction, runtime code, and editor tooling.

## Acceptance criteria
- Each upgraded object is a detailed model built from named submodels, not a plain primitive.
- Reusable objects are prefab assets under `Assets/Prefabs/Lab/`, instanced in the scene.
- Existing anchors are preserved: the stage top stays at exactly `Y=0`, the floor stays below it, and walkable surfaces keep their current top height.
- Replaced loose scene objects are named in the task Scope before deletion.
- Null-material scan returns zero; bounds and intersection scan shows no overlap above a few centimeters.
- Unity console has no new errors; scene saved; per-prop and wide screenshots captured as evidence.
- Validation evidence recorded on the task with residual risk and a named next step.
